conflicts.permit: We may also share anonymized data, such as statistical or demographic information in aggregate form, with third parties for research or marketing purposes.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not sell or disclose deidentified Personal Information to third parties.

conflicts.reason: One provision explicitly permits sharing anonymized data with third parties for research or marketing, while another categorically denies disclosing deidentified personal information to third parties without reconciliation.
